since: GA; core Databricks platform since inception; coauthoring GA Nov 2025; Genie Code GA Mar 2026

children.note: IDE with syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, cell-based execution, keyboard shortcuts; supports Python, SQL, R, and Scala for flexible development workflows.
Multiple users edit same cells simultaneously with live cursor visibility; persistent chat context across page navigation; email notifications on comment activity.
Code-section highlighting with comments; user mentions via @mention; Genie Code integration for AI explanations/suggestions directly in comment threads.
Native Git integration with branch management, commit tracking, merge conflict resolution; notebooks and files versioned in Git; supports CI/CD workflows.
Notebook widgets enable interactive input parameters for dashboards and reports; dbutils.widgets module for programmatic parameter management.
Chat pane for code generation, debugging, multi-step workflows; works with Unity Catalog tables/columns/lineage; generates and executes code directly in cells.
Automatic data visualization; built-in plotting libraries (matplotlib, plotly); point-and-click visualization editor; shareable interactive dashboards from notebook results.
Search/filter functionality in result tables; built-in column statistics; point-and-click chart creation from table data; Genie Code assistance for filtering.

since: GA; Lakeflow Designer GA Jun 2026; Catalog Explorer AI-assisted search GA 2026; dbutils.data.summarize() experimental mid-2026

children.note: Serverless SQL with Delta Lake; dashboards, materialized views, streaming tables for ad-hoc analytical exploration; result visualization and export.
PySpark and pandas-compatible APIs for distributed processing; pyspark.pandas for seamless scaling from pandas to distributed workloads.
Programmatic profiling of Spark/pandas DataFrames; summary statistics with configurable precision modes (~5% or ~0.0001% error); accessible from Python/Scala/R.
Built-in profiling showing histograms, distributions, null counts, and summary statistics for numeric, string, and date columns; accessible via + menu in result tables.
Drag-and-drop canvas for filtering, joining, aggregating, reshaping; natural language operator generation via Genie Code; backed by executable SQL/Spark code; Git-versionable.
Duplicate removal (drop_duplicates), missing value handling (fillna), date reformatting (pd.to_datetime); standard Pandas/Spark methods; Genie Code assists with NL prompts.
LLM-powered search for tables/models/functions; lineage tracking; data quality indicators; natural language prompt-driven table exploration (Public Preview).
Multiple chart types (line, scatter, bar, time-series); built-in rendering via display(); plotly interactive features; Lakeview dashboard embedding for nested analytics.

since: GA; UC integration evolved 2024–2026; Feature Views PuP 2026; Online Store (Lakebase) GA Feb 2026; Lineage GA 2025–2026

children.note: Any Delta table with primary key constraint serves as feature table; three-level UC namespace (catalog.schema.table); supports incremental updates via merge mode; versioning via delta commits.
Declarative feature definitions with automatic pipeline management; supports batch (scheduled), streaming (Kafka/CDF), and hybrid modes; FeatureEngineeringClient orchestrates compute.
Python UDFs governed by UC; computed at training/serving time; eliminates pre-materialization overhead; automatic integration with Model Serving; handles missing values gracefully.
Constructs training datasets with feature values at specific historical moments; eliminates train/serving skew; create_training_set API with temporal correctness guarantees.
Sub-millisecond latency lookup via managed PostgreSQL; read replicas (up to 3) for distributed query load; automatic sync from offline tables (triggered/continuous/snapshot modes).
REST endpoints for direct feature retrieval; Model Serving integration with automatic feature lookup; applies dynamic feature resolution and retrieval during inference requests.
Key-value tagging for categorization; Features UI search by name/comments/tags; cross-workspace sharing within metastore; Catalog Explorer integration for lineage visualization.
Automatic capture via log_model(); tracks feature tables, functions, and models used in training; lineage graph in Catalog Explorer; governance via Unity Catalog permissions.
